$comment: Search paraphrases for OpenSearch retrieval — not curriculum. Module 4 owns the named misconception text in /content; this file only lists example student predictions so a NL query can be narrowed to candidate scenes.
free-fall: a heavier ball falls faster than a light one
heavy objects hit the ground first
the 5 kg mass lands before the 100 g mass
feathers fall slower because they are lighter
projectile: velocity is zero at the top of the arc
the ball stops at the highest point
force points along the path of the projectile
nothing is acting on it at the top
pendulum: heavier pendulum has a shorter period
mass changes how fast it swings
replace the bob with a heavier one and it will go quicker
circular-motion: there is an outward force in a circle
centrifugal force pushes you out of the turn
you feel a force away from the center
elastic-collision: the heavier object always wins a collision
the big ball keeps going and the small one bounces back
mass alone decides who moves forward
a heavier cart always knocks the lighter one away
spring-shm: energy gets used up as the spring oscillates
the spring slows down because motion uses energy
it stops because the energy runs out
